messages:
jess: Hey - need to repro a weird prompt truncation in staging. Would like to capture full request headers + request body for POST /v1/generate for ~8hrs so SRE can reproduce. It contains X-User-Id and an Authorization: Bearer <token>. Is temporary logging of headers/bodies OK if we scope to staging + 24h retention? @samir @mike

samir: We should avoid storing raw identifiers. For headers: never persist full tokens. Options: redact Authorization entirely and store a hashed token suffix for debugging. For user ids, store a sha256 hash/pseudonym. cc @sec-bot

jess: Proposed approach:
- For Authorization -> replace with `Bearer <REDACTED>` and emit `token_suffix_hash=sha256(last6)`
- For X-User-Id -> emit `user_hash=sha256(id)`
- Request body (prompt) -> store first 200 chars + `prompt_hash=sha256(full_prompt)`
Will set sampling to 100% only for the failing endpoint and timebox to 8hrs and retention to 24h. Safe?

rachel: Quick governance Q: does this need manager + security signoff or is security on-call enough for staging ephemeral captures? I thought ephemeral staging captures required one security approver.

sec-bot: [AUTO] Logging policy v2.1: - Auth tokens MUST be redacted (no full token persistence). - PII must be pseudonymized or hashed. - Temporary capture (<72h) requires 1 security approver + 1 engineer. Use `ephemeral_capture=true` flag and set retention TTL. See https://intra.redwood/sec/policy/logging

mike: I can approve 24h in staging. Samir: please add proxy masking + feature flag. Jess: list exact endpoints and sampling rate in the ticket.

samir: Here's a minimal masking config snippet we can drop into the proxy (example):

```
# header masks
Authorization: regex_replace("^Bearer\\s.+$", "Bearer <REDACTED>")
X-User-Id: transform("sha256")
# body handling for prompt
json_path: $.prompt => store_prefix(200); prompt_hash = sha256(full_value)
```

Also add `token_suffix_hash = sha256(last6chars_of_token)` as a separate field for correlating without storing the token.

jess: Details for the ticket: POST /v1/generate (service=runtime), sample=100% for 8h, retention=24h, ticket: https://tickets/redwood/INC-8421. I'll request the security sign-off and cc @rachel for audit.

rachel: Added audit note in the ticket. Make sure hashes are computed with a secure salt or KMS-managed secret so they aren't reversible. Also ensure deletion job runs and there's an alert if TTL fails.

mike: Approved. Condition: run only in staging, 24h retention, flag off after expiry, and create an expiry alert. :thumbsup:

jess: Thanks all — I'll open the PR with the proxy changes behind `feature/ephemeral-log` flag and post the link here once ready.
